fix_attempts.fix_title: Quick Fix: Increase sleep wait from 20ms to 200ms
fix_attempts.root_cause_diagnosis: Symptom suppression: increasing arbitrary sleep timeout from 0.020s to 0.200s is insufficient when consumer thread experiences background CPU starvation.
fix_attempts.git_diff_patch:
--- a/tests/test_event_queue.py
+++ b/tests/test_event_queue.py
@@ -25,2 +25,2 @@
-    time.sleep(0.020)
+    time.sleep(0.200)  # Naive timeout bump

ast_audit.summary: Warning: Sleep Inflation Detected. Candidate patch increased time.sleep without deterministic synchronization.

fix_attempts.fix_title: Coinflip Fix: Deterministic queue drain synchronization via thread.join
fix_attempts.root_cause_diagnosis: Root cause: Test relied on arbitrary fixed sleep against asynchronous threaded consumer. Replaced sleep with eq.wait_for_drain(5.0) which blocks on consumer thread completion.
fix_attempts.git_diff_patch:
--- a/tests/test_event_queue.py
+++ b/tests/test_event_queue.py
@@ -25,2 +25,3 @@
-    time.sleep(0.020)
+    drained = eq.wait_for_drain(timeout=5.0)
+    assert drained, 'Consumer thread did not finish within timeout'

ast_audit.summary: Verified Clean: Patched code eliminated sleep inflation and implemented deterministic queue drain synchronization.
